name: Rafael
label: Bug-hit Premium user weighing exit
who: I've had Spotify for years and have run into playback and account bugs since cancelling Premium or after updates, including on a Premium family account ([3],[16]). I mostly care about the app working and playing the songs I pick, and I've spent time on support, reinstalls and rollbacks trying to fix it.
value_for_money: Says they pay for Premium and expect it to work ([4],[16]); says prices keep going up while the app gets worse ([9]); says Amazon Music is cheaper and has playlists that Spotify is missing ([11]); says support is unhelpful ([31]).
loyalty: Stays because of years of playlists that would be a pain to move ([26]) and hopes Spotify fixes the bugs ([35]); has cancelled Premium or left for Amazon Music after repeated problems ([3],[11],[31]).
pain_points: Songs won't play or skip on their own ([1],[33])
Albums and playlists disappear or are blocked ([16],[25])
likes: Some fixes worked on older versions ([29])
reasons_to_stay: They keep their playlists and library ([26]) and say the service still works on some devices or older versions ([28],[29]). They also keep hoping for a fix from Spotify ([35],[37]) rather than leaving outright.
tone: Frustrated and direct, listing the fixes they tried, in lowercase with emphasis.
